verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers loading data into MotherDuck (uploading DuckDB files, connecting to Postgres/MySQL, S3 integration) and various query/access surfaces (CLI, Postgres endpoint, MCP, dbt), but there is no documentation of an explicit bulk-export or 'take all your data and leave' capability in open formats (e.g., dumping all tables to Parquet/CSV or full database export for migration away from MotherDuck). Missing for 10: explicit export/download-all-data documentation, open-format bulk export tooling, and any migration-out guide or independent confirmation of full data portability.
